name: ecomacademy-skills
description: Claude Code skills and plugins for Shopify merchants — by Ecommerce Academy.

plugins.name: eca-ecommerce-agent
plugins.description: Ecommerce Academy skills bundle — brand intelligence, hero product analysis, email marketing campaigns, competitor analysis, Meta ad copywriting, customer persona building, SEO and AI blog writing, UGC video scripts, store visibility audits, Meta ads analysis (4PI), and post-purchase surveys from writing the questions to turning the answers into angles, objections and personas. New skills are added here over time; installing this one plugin keeps you current with all of them.  What's new (v1.16.0): Brand file now lives in your working folder (./brand/brand-data.md) and syncs to EcomOS — every Marketing App and the AI coach there use it; say "Sync my brand to EcomOS".

plugins.name: eca-operations-agent
plugins.description: Ecommerce Academy Operations Coworker — the daily running of the store. A morning brief that reads Shopify, Meta Ads and your inbox and tells you what needs doing today, a customer service skill that drafts your replies and learns which ones it can handle alone, a landing page builder that installs into your theme, and a skill builder that turns any repeatable task of yours into a reusable skill.

plugins.name: eca-black-friday-blueprint
plugins.description: Ecommerce Academy Black Friday Blueprint — everything you need to plan and run BFCM. Decide a data-backed offer from last year's numbers, lock the phase calendar, then build the email programme and the ad creative off the back of it. Three skills sharing one set of campaign files, so the offer, the dates, every send and every ad live in the same runsheet and dashboard. The ads skill needs Higgsfield connected to generate images, and produces a full creative brief and prompt when it is not.

plugins.name: eca-reel-editor
plugins.description: Ecommerce Academy Reel Editor — drop a raw talking-head clip into Claude Code and get back a finished vertical reel or Meta video ad in your own brand: cleaned audio, filler words cut, captions and graphics that match what you say, plus product, review and offer cards from your Shopify store. Brand comes from the Marketing Coworker's brand-data.md (no interview); products and reel logging come from EcomOS when connected. Runs on your own computer — footage never leaves it. Built on Nicola Pocock's claude-reel-editor (MIT).
